plainTranslation: The Sun person brings identity and vitality to the Saturn person's structure, while Saturn asks for seriousness. This can become loyalty and long-range building. It can also make the Sun person feel watched or measured, so the bond needs encouragement as much as accountability.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
